g.text: Regulatory Change Impact Intelligence — Agent Workflow Architecture
Foundry / Microsoft Agent Framework boundary + Fabric Agent Harness · Entra-only auth · Parquet → Fabric Lakehouse / Purview / Power BI
• Grounds Fabric agents on Lakehouse data
• Entra-only auth — no API keys, no Semantic Kernel, no offline fallback path for agent behavior
• Schema validation on every agent response (contracts.py) — hard-fail on ValidationError
• Ruff lint + pytest regression gates in CI
• PipelineEvent observability stream (agents/events.py, pipeline.py) — stage_start / stage_end / stage_error / tool_call
• Foundry + Fabric wrapping stays behind adapters so Foundry Hosted Agent deployment can be added without rebinding core logic
